seashroud-algae.x: Seashroud algae is an animal product that can be obtained from a well fed adult [[seashroud|Seashroud]]. To collect it, the player needs a pair of [[shears|Shears]] purchased at the Ranch for 400or.

horse.x: Horse is a mountable animal. Horse can be purchased from [[ranch|Ranch]] once a [[stable|stable]] is built. Only 1 horse can be owned. Unlike other [[farm-animal|farm animal]]s horse does not require caring.

mermoo.x: Mermoo are animals that the player can raise in an [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]]. There also can only be 2 Mermoo per [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]], more then 2 can make them unhappy.

Purchasable for 14,000 from Slamets [[underwater-ranch|Underwater Ranch]] shop once the player has bought an [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]] from him, and completed the Dua Pulu offering in the 20m depth regions [[orchestra-sites|Orchestra sites]].
[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult mermoo will produce mermoo milk every 1 Day. In order to obtain mermoo milk, the player needs a [[milk-pail|Milk pail]] purchased at the Ranch for 300or.

Mermoo milk can be used in . It can be used to make mermoo butter in a [[mason-jar|mason jar]] and mermoo cheese in a [[cheese-press|cheese press]] that can be further processed into fermented mermoo cheese in an [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]].

seashroud.x: Seashroud are animals that the player can raise in a [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]].

Purchasable for 18,000 from Slamets [[underwater-ranch|Underwater Ranch]] shop once the player has bought an [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]] from him, and completed the Empat Pulu offering in the 40m depth regions [[orchestra-sites|Orchestra sites]].

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult seashroud will produce seashroud algae. In order to obtain seashroud algae, the player needs a pair of [[shears|Shears]] purchased at the Ranch for 400or. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the seashroud algae depends on the mood and heart level.
Seashroud algae can be used in [[loom|Loom]] to make seashroud yarn.

carapoultry.x: Carapoultry are animals that the player can raise in an [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]].

Purchasable for 8,000 from Slamets [[underwater-ranch|Underwater Ranch]] shop once the player has bought an [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]] from him, and completed the Dua Pulu offering in the 20m depth regions [[orchestra-sites|Orchestra sites]].

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult carapoultry will produce cara egg every 2 days. Cara egg can be put inside the [[mayonnaise-machine|mayonnaise machine]] to produce cara egg mayonnaise or [[mason-jar|mason jar]] to produce salted cara egg which can be further processed by [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]] for century cara egg.

inkhog.x: Inkhog are animals that the player can raise in an [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]].

Purchasable for 9,000 from Slamets [[underwater-ranch|Underwater Ranch]] shop once the player has bought an [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]] from him, and completed the Empat Pulu offering in the 40m depth regions [[orchestra-sites|Orchestra sites]].
[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult Inkhog will produce deepvoid ink every 1 Day. In order to obtain deepvoid ink, the player needs a [[milk-pail|Milk pail]] purchased at the Ranch for 300or.
Deepvoid ink can be used in . It can be used to make black oil in an [[oil-press|oil press]].

buffalo.x: Buffalo are [[farm-animal|farm animals]] the player can raise in a level 2 [[barn|barn]]. They are unlocked after reaching [[town-rank|town rank]] A.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult buffalo will produce buffalo milk. In order to obtain buffalo milk, the player needs a [[milk-pail|Milk pail]] purchased at the Ranch for 300or. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the milk depends on the mood and heart level.

Buffalo milk can be used in . It can be used to make buffalo butter in [[mason-jar|mason jar]] and buffalo cheese in [[cheese-press|cheese press]] that can be further processed into aged buffalo cheese in an [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]].

large-buffalo-milk.x: Large buffalo milk is an animal product that can only be produced by adult [[buffalo|Buffalo]]. To collect it, the player will also need to buy a [[milk-pail|Milk pail]] from the [[ranch|Ranch]] for 300 or.

ostrich.x: Ostrich are [[farm-animal|farm animals]] that the player can raise in a level 2 [[coop|coop]]. They are unlocked after the player meets [[lady-lavanna|Lady Lavanna]] and gains access to her [[savannah-ranch|ranch]].

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult ostrich will produce ostrich egg. Ostrich egg can be put inside the [[mayonnaise-machine|mayonnaise machine]] to produce ostrich mayonnaise or [[mason-jar|mason jar]] to produce salted ostrich egg which can be further processed by [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]] for century ostrich egg. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the eggs depends on the mood and heart level.

large-ostrich-egg.x: Large ostrich egg is an animal product that can be obtained from a well fed adult [[ostrich|Ostrich]].

large-cara-egg.x: Large cara egg is an animal product that can be obtained from a well fed adult [[carapoultry|carapoultry]].

large-mermoo-milk.x: Large mermoo milk is an animal product that can be obtained from a well fed adult [[mermoo|mermoo]]. To collect it, the player will also need to buy a Milk Pail from the [[ranch|Ranch]] for 300 or.

shelluck.x: Shelluck are animals that the player can raise in an [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]]. Only 4 Shelluck can be kept on the underwater farm.

Purchasable for 30,000 from Slamets [[underwater-ranch|Underwater Ranch]] shop once the player has bought an [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]] from him, and completed the Lima Pulu offering in the 50m regions [[orchestra-sites|Orchestra sites]].
[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult Shelluck will produce pearl every 6 Days.
[[farm-animal|Type]] of the pearl depends on the mood and heart level of the shelluck.

large-deepvoid-ink.x: Large deepvoid ink is an animal product that can be obtained from a well fed adult [[inkhog|Inkhog]]. To collect it, the player will also need to buy a Milk Pail from the [[ranch|Ranch]] for 300 or.

white-pearl.x: White pearl is an animal product that can be obtained every 6 days from a well fed adult [[shelluck|Shelluck]].

black-pearl.x: Black pearl is an animal product that can be obtained every 6 days from a well fed adult [[shelluck|Shelluck]].

large-starlet-egg.x: Large starlet egg is an animal product that can be obtained daily from a well fed adult [[chicken|chicken]].

large-goat-milk.x: Large goat milk is an animal product that can only be produced by adult [[goat|goat]]. To collect it, the player will also need to buy a Milk Pail from the [[ranch|Ranch]] for 300 or.

Gesha coffee beans can be found by adult [[luwak|luwak]]s on the farm.

large-gesha-coffee-bean.x: Large gesha coffee bean is an animal product that can be produced by an adult [[luwak|luwak]].

black-truffle.x: Black truffle is an animal product that can only be produced by a [[pig|Pig]].
Truffle will only be produced if the pigs are outside and have access to grass. Truffle is considered as mushroom when cooking.

white-truffle.x: White truffle is an animal product that can only be produced by a [[pig|Pig]].
Truffle will only be produced if the pigs are outside and have access to grass. Truffle is considered as mushroom when cooking.

Golden egg can be processed into the following [[artisan-product|artisan products]]:

large-golden-egg.x: Large golden egg is an animal product that can be obtained daily from a well fed adult [[chicken|chicken]] that has won a Staring Contest at the [[animal-festival|Animal Festival]].
Large golden eggs can be used as any egg ingredient in cooking.

golden-milk.x: Golden milk is an animal product that can be obtained daily from a well fed adult [[cow|cow]] that has won a Contest at the [[animal-festival|Animal Festival]] by using a [[milk-pail|milk pail]].
Golden milk can be processed into the following [[artisan-product|artisan products]]:
It produces 2x amount with the same time required compared to the regular [[milk|milk]] but occupies 2 slots.

Large golden milk can be processed into the following [[artisan-product|artisan products]]:
It produces 2x amount with the same time required compared to the regular [[large-milk|large milk]] but occupies 2 slots.

cow.x: Cows are starter [[farm-animal|farm animals]] that the player can raise in a [[barn|barn]].

There are currently five color options when purchasing a cow: white, brown, and as town rank increases, pink, purple, and blue also become available. The rainbow color variations cost more but have a chance to produce starlet milk. Starlet milk sells for more than regular milk and also produces double artisan goods when placed in artisan equipment.
Cows have the ability to grow one of four different types of horns. These will appear once the baby cow grows into an adult.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult cow will produce milk every 1 Day. In order to obtain milk, the player needs a [[milk-pail|Milk pail]] purchased at the Ranch for 300or. If the cow won [[animal-festival|cow competition]] it will start producing golden milk instead. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the milk depends on the mood and heart level.

Milk can be used in . It can be used to make butter in a [[mason-jar|mason jar]] and cheese in a [[cheese-press|cheese press]] that can be further processed into aged cheese in an [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]].

chicken.x: Chickens are starter [[farm-animal|farm animals]] that the player can raise in a [[coop|coop]].
There are three types of Chickens revealed so far: White Chicken, Brown Chicken and Blue Chickens.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult chicken will produce egg daily. Egg can be put inside the [[mayonnaise-machine|mayonnaise machine]] to produce mayonnaise or [[mason-jar|mason jar]] to produce salted egg which can be further processed by [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]] for century egg. If the chicken won [[animal-festival|chicken competition]] it will start producing golden egg instead. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the eggs depends on the mood and heart level.

duck.x: Ducks are [[farm-animal|farm animals]] that the player can raise in a [[coop|coop]]. They are unlocked after reaching [[town-rank|town rank]] E.
There are two types of Ducks revealed so far: White Duck and Brown Duck.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult duck will produce duck egg every 2 days. Duck egg can be put inside the [[mayonnaise-machine|mayonnaise machine]] to produce duck mayonnaise or [[mason-jar|mason jar]] to produce salted duck egg which can be further processed by [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]] for century duck egg. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the eggs depends on the mood and heart level.

peafowl.x: Peafowls are [[farm-animal|farm animals]] that the player can raise in a level 2 [[coop|coop]]. They are unlocked after reaching [[town-rank|town rank]] C. Only 4 peafowls can be kept in the farm.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult peafowl will produce feather. The way it produces feather is a bit similar to [[pig|Pig]] and [[luwak|Luwak]], that it can drop feather throughout the whole day that it's supposed to produce. However, unlike the others, peafowl doesn't require to be outside and the product can be collected by [[auto-collector|auto collector]].
[[farm-animal|Size]] of the feathers depends on the mood and heart level.

quail.x: Quails are [[farm-animal|farm animals]] that the player can raise in a level 2 [[coop|coop]]. They are unlocked after reaching [[town-rank|town rank]] D.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult quail will produce quail egg. Quail egg can be put inside the [[mayonnaise-machine|mayonnaise machine]] to produce quail mayonnaise or [[mason-jar|mason jar]] to produce salted quail egg which can be further processed by [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]] for century quail egg. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the eggs depends on the mood and heart level.

goat.x: Goats are [[farm-animal|farm animals]] the player can raise in a level 2 [[barn|barn]]. They are unlocked after reaching [[town-rank|town rank]] D.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult goat will produce goat milk. In order to obtain goat milk, the player needs a [[milk-pail|Milk pail]] purchased at the Ranch for 300or. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the milk depends on the mood and heart level.

Goat milk can be used in . It can used to make goat butter in [[mason-jar|mason jar]] and goat cheese in [[cheese-press|cheese press]] that can be further processed into aged goat cheese in an [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]].

llama.x: Llamas are [[farm-animal|farm animals]] the player can raise in a level 2 [[barn|barn]]. Llamas are exclusively sold in pairs.
They are unlocked after reaching [[town-rank|town rank]] B.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult llama will produce llama wool. In order to obtain llama wool, the player needs a pair of [[shears|Shears]] purchased at the Ranch for 400or. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the wool depends on the mood and heart level.
Llama wool can be used in [[loom|Loom]] to make llama yarn.

luwak.x: Luwak, also known as Asian palm civets outside Indonesia, are [[farm-animal|farm animals]] the player can raise in a level 2 [[barn|barn]]. Luwak function similarly to pigs, except instead of truffles they are able to find gesha coffee beans for the player from around Coral Island, including rarer, high quality, coffee beans. Only 4 Luwak can be kept in the farm.
They are unlocked after reaching [[town-rank|town rank]] B.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult luwaks have the ability to find gesha coffee bean on the farm every two days. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the bean depends on the mood and heart level. While they do not require any tools, they need to be let out of the barn and have available grass in order to dig, e.g. on the third day after they are fed for two days. Luwak can't find any bean on rainy days. Gesha coffee beans will stay on the farm until they are collected.
Gesha coffee bean can be put inside the [[keg|keg]] to produce gesha coffee which can be further processed by [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]] for aged gesha coffee.

i: Ethical farming: The game devs have stated that their depiction of luwak is intended to evoke the mutually beneficial relationship of early interactions between humans and luwak, as they don't condone modern exploitative farming of kopi luwak (civet coffee).

pig.x: Pigs are [[farm-animal|farm animals]] the player can raise in a level 2 [[barn|barn]]. They are unlocked after reaching [[town-rank|town rank]] C.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult pigs have the ability to dig up truffles on the farm every three days. [[farm-animal|Type]] of the truffle depends on the mood and heart level. While they do not require any tools, they need to be let out of the barn and have available grass in order to dig, e.g. on the fourth day after they are fed for three days. Pig can't find any truffle on rainy days. Truffles will stay on the farm until they are collected.
Truffles can be used in [[oil-press|Oil press]] to make truffle oil.

sheep.x: Sheep are [[farm-animal|farm animals]] that the player can raise in a [[barn|barn]]. They are unlocked after reaching [[town-rank|town rank]] E.

[[farm-animal|Healthy and well fed]] adult sheep will produce wool every 2 Days. In order to obtain wool, the player needs a pair of [[shears|Shears]] purchased at the Ranch for 400or. [[farm-animal|Size]] of the wool depends on the mood and heart level.
Wool can be used in . It can be used to make wool cloth when placed in a [[loom|loom]].

temperature-machine.x: is an item sold in the [[ranch|Ranch]] near the foot of the forest. It is priced at 600 and available to buy at [[town-rank|town rank]] E.

Temperature machine serves as a protective shield for animals, ensuring their well-being by regulating the temperature inside the barn/coop in the [[summer|summer]] and [[winter|winter]]. Maintaining a suitable temperature can prevent illnesses that may arise due to weather conditions, it also improves animal's mood and comfort.
Before it can be crafted, it has to be developed from the [[laboratory|Laboratory]]. and its crafting recipe will be obtained afterward.
Once development is done, can be [[crafting|crafted]] by the player.

is needed to keep the well-being of ranch animals. It has to be placed in anywhere inside the area of the [[coop|coop]], [[barn|barn]], or [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]], The Temperature Machine remains inactive outside of the seasons in which it is needed and does not need to be removed when not in use. Temperature machine is required for underwater barn year round.

feather.x: Feathers are animal products that can be obtained every 4 days from a well fed adult [[peafowl|Peafowl]].

large-feather.x: Large feathers are animal products that can be obtained every 4 days from a well fed adult [[peafowl|Peafowl]].

auto-feeder.x: Auto feeder is an item that automatically places [[hay|hay]] from a [[silo|silo]] to the feeder in [[coop|coop]] or [[barn|barn]]. Unlike other ranching equipment, its installation location is pre-determined above the feed trough. It will start working on the day it's installed. The Auto Feeder can be uninstalled by approaching it and selecting the "Remove" interaction.

As of the current version, the Auto Feeder cannot be used in the [[underwater-barn|Underwater Barn]], as there is no underwater silo. However, the feature may be added in a future update, as it has been teased in Stairway Games' developer diary.
Before it can be crafted, it has to be developed from the [[laboratory|Laboratory]]. Auto feeder and its crafting recipe will be obtained afterward.
Once development is done, auto feeder can be [[crafting|crafted]] by the player.

The auto feeder has to be placed in a pre-determined location in the [[coop|coop]] or [[barn|barn]]. The auto feeder displays a visual text notification if the [[hay|hay]] in the [[silo|silo]] supplying the auto feeder is running low or out of stock.
The Auto Feeder can be uninstalled by approaching it and selecting the "Remove" interaction.

auto-petter.x: is an item that automatically pets [[farm-animal|farm animal]] in [[coop|coop]], [[barn|barn]], or [[underwater-barn|Underwater barn]] every morning. It will not pet new farm animals bought for that day. It will only start working on the following day after it's installed.
Similar to other automation machines, the Auto petter does not grant Ranching Mastery experience points. The Auto Petter can also be used in the Underwater Barn.
The recipe has to be developed in the [[laboratory|Laboratory]].
Once development is complete, the can be [[crafting|crafted]] by the player.
has to be placed in the [[coop|coop]], [[barn|barn]], or [[underwater-barn|Underwater barn]]. It can be uninstalled by breaking it with axe or pickaxe.

auto-collector.x: automatically collects produce from [[farm-animal|farm animal]]s every morning. It can be used in the [[barn|Barn]], [[coop|Coop]], and [[underwater-barn|Underwater barn]]. The auto collector begins to work the next day after installation. It will also collect any product that was not collected before installation. It has 20 storage slots and will indicate if there's anything stored inside.
Before it can be crafted, the recipe has to be developed in the [[laboratory|Laboratory]].
After initial development, the can be [[crafting|crafted]] by the player.

has to be placed in the [[coop|coop]], [[barn|Barn]], or [[underwater-barn|Underwater barn]]. The auto collector can be repositioned and moved within the building. At this point, it seems that it cannot be moved once placed in the underwater barn.
